what: Not a personal-data law and not a data-location rule, but a central bank instruction on personal data: the Central Bank of Yemen, Head Office - Aden, financial consumer protection instructions dated 20/8/2023 (YE-F208, YE-F209), which apply to providers of financial products and services under its supervision (ocr.txt line 30), require "الإمتثال لمتطلبات خصوصية البيانات وسريتها التي تقيد استخدام ببانات المستبلك إلا للغرض الذي جعت البيانات من أجله" (lines 935 and 937, OCR as held) and "صياغة وتنفيل السياسات والإجراءات اللازمة لضمان سرية معلومات المستباك وأمنهاء وسلامتها" (line 941). The point's own "what would show it" names an "authority instruction on personal data"; this one binds financial service providers at the Aden central bank's area as of 2023-08-20, not platforms, and says nothing of where data is held. No record or file shows a data-location rule (the Sana'a rules search's finding aid, evidence/yemen/finding-aids/20261010-sanaa-rules-search.md line 115: "no Sana'a-side law or rule was found on electronic transactions or data localisation"); item F04 (UNCTAD) lists Yemen only among bills "on cybercrime" (line 55).
